text.body: ॥ śrī nīlakaṇṭhanamaśśivāyāṣṭakam ॥ namo namaḥ kāraṇakāraṇāya jaganmayāyāhitapāśakāya । tvatpādapadmāśritarakṣakāya śrī nīlakaṇṭhāya namaśśivāya ॥ 1 dhyāyanti ye tvāṃ yatayaḥ stuvanti hṛdaṃbuje dīpasamaprakāśam । nāsāpravinyastavilocanāya śrī nīlakaṇṭhāya namaśśivāya ॥ 2 sargasthitidhvaṃsanakāraṇāya yamādiyogāṣṭakasiddhidāya । tapasvināṃ śīghraphalapradāya śrī ... ॥ 3 vedādirūpāya trilocanāya vedāntavedyāya digambarāya । vibhūtiśubhrāya jaṭādharāya śrī ... ॥ 4 ugrāya saṃsārabhayāpahāya jñānapradāyāśusukhapradāya । kālāntakāya pralayānilāya śrī ... ॥ 5 vidhātṛrūpāya jagaddhitāya rameśarūpāya sadāśivāya । anantarūpāya caturbhujāya śrī ... ॥ 6 viśvaikavandyāya kalādharāya samastalokaikasamāśrayāya । kuṭhārapāśāṅkuśapāline ca śrī ... ॥ 7 śarvāya sarvapriyakāraṇāya pinākine bāṇadharāya tubhyam । gaurīpriyāyākhilapālakāya śrī ... ॥ 8 iti stutvā mahādevaṃ praṇamya ca punaḥ punaḥ । nidadhyū ṛṣayastatra surāḥ padmabhuvādayaḥ ।। 9 iti śrīskāndapurāṇe śrīgaralapurīnāthamāhātmye śrī nīlakaṇṭhanamaśśivāyāṣṭakam ॥
